title: SWF: PlaceObject3 with filter list encoding
description: Test that a SymbolInstance with filters array produces PlaceObject3 (tag 70) with HasFilterList flag. Verify: (1) tag 70 appears when filters are present, (2) filters array count matches number of filters in body, (3) no PlaceObject3 when filters array is empty or absent, (4) DropShadow filter type byte is 0x00, GlowFilter is 0x06, BlurFilter is 0x01 per SWF spec. Check engine/types.ts for filter types.
